Overnight shifts (clock-out before clock-in) count as next-day. Breaks are unpaid.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter clock-in, clock-out and unpaid break minutes for each day you worked.
  2. Leave days you did not work blank.
  3. Optionally enter your hourly rate for a pay estimate.
  4. Press Calculate for per-day hours, the week total and overtime.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are overnight shifts handled?

As an overnight shift — the clock-out is assumed to be the next day. So 22:00 to 06:00 counts as 8 hours.

What counts as overtime?

Anything over 40 hours in the week counts as overtime. This is the common US-style threshold, not a legal ruling for your country.

Is the pay estimate shown without a rate?

Only if you enter an hourly rate. Leave the rate blank and you get hours without the pay estimate.
